The server accepts reasoning_effort low, medium and xhigh only. Register it with those accepted reasoning levels (Settings → Custom model servers); GAID then sends minimal as low and high as medium and shows the substitution in the thinking selector. Without the setting, minimal, high and xhigh (sent as high) fail with HTTP 400. With off the server still reasons at its default.

Tasks before the 2026-10-14 follow-up ran without catalogue skills in the project and at thinking off; the re-trial ran with skills and thinking high (sent as medium), so the two changes are not separated.
